item.seancraft.soda.desc: Sean's own brand. Tastes like a thunderstorm. A full meal and Health Boost for 20 minutes.
item.seancraft.merch.desc: Official Sean merch. It's black. It does nothing. It's drip. Sean's Security leaves wearers alone.
item.seancraft.glock.desc: Semi-automatic. Sean says it's for 'weather emergencies'. Uses arrows.
item.seancraft.restraining_order.desc: Joe has to stay 15 blocks away while you carry this. Void if you hit him. Does not cover the Baby Wars.
item.seancraft.diddy_oil.desc: Slippery. Speed and Resistance for 5 minutes.
item.seancraft.sixty_seven.desc: Six. Seven. End-game fists. Sean won't say where he got them.
item.seancraft.baby_bonnet.desc: Joe's gift to veterans of the Baby Wars. Wear it and his babies treat you as one of their own. Sean's Security does not.
item.seancraft.orb_of_regret.desc: Above level 40, the Altar of Regret demands one of these, on top of your life.
block.seancraft.altar_of_regret.desc: Use it to clear your passive web. It kills you, and above level 20 you don't get every point back.
item.seancraft.altar_of_regret.desc: Use it to clear your passive web. It kills you, and above level 20 you don't get every point back.
item.seancraft.summoning_pedestal.desc: The heart of a boss arena. Use a boss's totem on it to start the fight.
item.seancraft.trophy_rack.desc: Put boss trophies on it at your home base, then use it to choose your trophy power (Y).
item.seancraft.mark_totem.desc: He's been here longer than you. "Has this been approved?" Use it on a Summoning Pedestal.
item.seancraft.marks_reel.desc: A grapple rod: hook a block up to 24 blocks away and get pulled to it.
item.seancraft.bo_daddy_totem.desc: Definitely legendary. "Watch him, not the music." Use it on a Summoning Pedestal.
item.seancraft.subwoofer.desc: One bass hit: every mob within 32 blocks shows through walls for 5 seconds.
item.seancraft.daylan_totem.desc: New week, new me. "His followers aren't real." Use it on a Summoning Pedestal.
item.seancraft.follower_lantern.desc: His one real follower. Carry it and Darkness can't touch you.
item.seancraft.fire_arrow.desc: Pierce damage with some fire on top, and it sets what it hits alight.
item.seancraft.bandage.desc: Stops a light bleed. Use it, or pick the part on the STATUS screen (H).
item.seancraft.tourniquet.desc: Stops any bleed. Arms and legs only. Use it, or pick the part on the STATUS screen (H).
item.seancraft.splint.desc: Sets a fractured arm or leg. Use it, or pick the part on the STATUS screen (H).
item.seancraft.painkillers.desc: Hides fracture and destroyed-limb effects for 5 minutes. Use it, or pick the part on the STATUS screen (H).
item.seancraft.field_kit.desc: Stops a part's bleeds and heals it 30% of max health. Use it, or pick the part on the STATUS screen (H).
item.seancraft.surgical_kit.desc: Restores a destroyed part, stops its bleeding, sets it and heals it, but leaves lasting damage: the part only heals to 65%. Use it, or pick the part on the STATUS screen (H).
item.seancraft.surgery_case.desc: Brings a part back to new: restores it if destroyed, stops bleeds, sets fractures, heals it fully and clears lasting damage. Use it, or pick the part on the STATUS screen (H).
item.seancraft.weapon_bench.desc: Put a weapon or armor piece in to swap its parts and level them up.
item.seancraft.antidote.desc: Drink to cure every harmful effect (poison, wither, hunger, nausea...). Or use it from the STATUS tab.
item.seancraft.workshop.desc: Home module: faster furnaces, and at level 3 half-price repairs at the Weapon Bench. Place it at your home base and use it to build.
item.seancraft.medstation.desc: Home module: meds to make, and bleeds and fractures heal at home. Place it at your home base and use it to build.
item.seancraft.perimeter.desc: Home module: a bigger home radius. Place it at your home base and use it to build.
item.seancraft.buckler.desc: Blademaster only. Blocks 60% of a frontal hit, with a wider parry window. Light.
item.seancraft.tower_shield.desc: Knight only. Blocks everything in front, arrows too, but can't parry and slows you while raised. Heavy.
item.seancraft.arrow_broadhead.desc: Bleeds are half again as bad, but it gets through less armor.
item.seancraft.arrow_blunt.desc: Blunt damage: breaks bones and staggers instead of bleeding.
item.seancraft.boomerang.desc: Hold use to wind up, release to throw. It comes back.
item.seancraft.home_bench.desc: Everything within its radius is your home base: no hostile spawns, and the place to build modules. One per player; placing another picks up your oldest.
item.seancraft.camp.desc: A tent and a fire. Respawn here, rest here, swap your loadout here. Sneak-use to pack it up.
item.seancraft.camp_kit.desc: Set it down for a camp: a respawn point, a fire and a roof, and no hostile spawns nearby. One per player; a new one packs up the old.
item.seancraft.map_room.desc: Home module: a season and weather forecast when you come home, and hunting party warnings for everyone. Place it at your home base and use it to build.
item.seancraft.storehouse.desc: Home module: turns the chests at your home base into one stash, then filters and refill, then the stash at every station. Place it at your home base and use it to build.
